what: T-Mobile US is one of the three large US wireless carriers. It sells mobile plans, home internet over its 5G network and, more recently, fibre broadband.
money: monthly plans for phones and home internet
moat: The strongest mid-band 5G spectrum position in the US and a record of taking customers from rivals.
opportunities: Analysts see about 40% upside from current levels
Its spectrum position gives it the best 5G coverage in the United States, which keeps winning subscribers
watch: Postpaid phone net additions and service revenue growth.
